text:
250 days = 8 months (approx) but need exact count.  
1131 is not a leap year (divisible by 4? 1131/4=282.75, no).  
From 12-11-1131:  
Days in Nov 1131: 30, so 12 Nov → 30 Nov = 18 days.  
Remaining: 250 − 18 = 232 days.  
Dec 1131: 31 days → 232 − 31 = 201.  
Jan 1132: 31 → 201 − 31 = 170.  
Feb 1132: 29? 1132 divisible by 4 = 283 exactly → leap year → 29 days → 170 − 29 = 141.  
Mar 1132: 31 → 141 − 31 = 110.  
Apr 1132: 30 → 110 − 30 = 80.  
May 1132: 31 → 80 − 31 = 49.  
Jun 1132: 30 → 49 − 30 = 19.  
Jul 1132: 19 days left → July 19, 1132.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1132-07-19
